title: The card standing in the plate

members.role: the page stands as a card at a parallax depth on a layered plate - the world has planes and the proof lives on one
the card is tilted on the page plane, its numbers upright at their projected anchors
a dock rides the mid plane under the camera move that already had a reason, parallaxing between the plate and the card

does: The page stands inside the plate instead of over it: a card at a parallax depth, tilted on its plane, with a dock riding the mid plane under a camera move the sentence already earned.
